description: Look up a food additive, flavouring, contaminant or veterinary drug in the WHO/FAO JECFA database by substance name, CAS number, or INS/E-number (E951, INS 951, 160a). Returns the Acceptable Daily Intake (ADI), CAS number, functional class and a chemical id for fetching the full safety evaluation. Use this to answer whether a substance has been evaluated for safety and what intake level was judged acceptable.

query.description: Substance name or fragment ("aspartame", "sunset yellow"), CAS number ("22389-47-0"), or INS/E-number ("E951", "951", "160a(iii)").

name: jecfa_search
title: Jecfa Search
